topic: Conversion display for BITE and J&J
summary_markdown:
Someone requested an interface screenshot showing conversion metrics for BITE to use as an example in responses regarding the UK. [me] suggested using the existing conversion data for J&J in Afa malls as a temporary substitute.

[p1] confirmed that the required image was successfully inserted.
decisions: Use existing J&J conversion data (Afa malls) as placeholder for BITE conversion screenshot.
